description:

**Category:** `security`
**Flagged by:** Ollama (glm-5.3-flash:cloud)

**Suggested Fix:**
```
Canonize both sides the same way: compute repo_root with realpath too (falling back to the same cd/pwd logic), and in the fallback branch, resolve $f through readlink -f when available or reject paths whose dirname contains a symlink component.
```
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure changes satisfy security, performance, and correctness standards
Verify git diff and tests pass without regressions

Apply suggested fix: Canonize both sides the same way: compute repo_root with realpath too (falling back to the same cd/pwd logic), and in the fallback branch, resolve $f through readlink -f when available or reject paths whose dirname contains a symlink component.
